title: LRHE shadow-ledger review record
description:
One record per production review. findings.jsonl is per finding and cannot answer 'what was this review like before anyone looked at it' -- which is exactly the question a router has to answer. This is that record, and it is the only place the router's inputs may come from.

The structure enforces one rule: `features` is frozen at dispatch, before any reviewer output exists, and `outcomes` accrues afterwards. Anything computable only after the review is a LABEL, not a feature, and putting it in `features` trains the router to predict the present from the future. That failure is invisible in offline evaluation -- the model looks excellent and is worthless live -- so the separation is structural rather than a convention.

epoch_commit.description: the tree every reviewer saw. Two reviewers on different epochs are not comparable and their findings must not share a review_id

panel.description: who was actually dispatched, with the exact model each served. A router that learns `family=claude is good` without knowing which Claude has learned nothing transferable

visibility.description: live-workflow only. Shadow lanes must be withheld until the baseline ledger is frozen, or independent contribution and synthesis contamination become indistinguishable

features.description: KNOWABLE BEFORE DISPATCH. Every field here must be computable from the diff and the repository at epoch_commit, with no reviewer output and no outcome. If you cannot compute it at features_frozen_at, it does not belong here.

packet_tokens.description: drives cost prediction directly, and is the one feature that is cheap, exact, and available before dispatch

indicators.description: cheap static signals for the failure classes the lenses are designed around. Presence is a hint, never a verdict

features_frozen_at.description: when `features` was computed. It must precede every run's started_at; the builder refuses an example whose features were frozen after its reviewer ran

outcomes.description: ACCRUES AFTER. Never a router input. `escaped_defect` in particular only becomes true with time, so an example labelled the day of review is not comparable to one labelled ninety days later -- see label_maturity_days on the example.

decision_changed.description: did the review change what shipped. The outcome the whole apparatus exists to produce

escaped_defect.description: a defect reached production that this review could have caught

observed_through.description: how far forward history was actually examined. Absent means the outcome window is unknown and the labels cannot be aged

data_rights_record_ids.description: the egress decisions that cleared this review. Retention policy requires deletion and provenance lineage: without these a later takedown cannot find what to remove
